newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian Socialists agree to early elections.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian Socialists agree to early elections.

text.p: Bulgaria's ruling Socialist party said on Monday it was prepared to discuss an early general election with the opposition and had drafted a programme to bring the country out of its political and economic crisis.

"We are ready to talk about early parliamentary elections in the context of the implementation of the anti-crisis programme," said a statement read to reporters after a meeting of the party's leadership.

The bureau proposes "to accept in principle the idea of holding early parliamentary elections in the context of implementation of a national anti-crisis programme for economic and financial stabilisation of Bulgaria," the statement said.

"The current situation calls for extraordinary economic actions and, principally, new decisions which can be implemented under the strict observance of the constitution and laws, and maximum social support."
Opposition supporters rallied in the capital and 20 towns across Bulgaria on Monday as protests calling for an election nearly two years ahead of schedule entered their second week.
